title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social activities and public spaces at Bethel University, from lakeside nature trails and disc golf to student-led worship and gallery exhibits.

cards.title: Play a Round of Disc Golf
cards.subtitle: 18-hole course near Lake Valentine
cards.notes: Challenge friends on this top-ranked 18-hole course. It is free for students and the public, featuring wooded lines and elevation changes.
cards.short_summary: A highly-ranked 18-hole disc golf course open to the public and students for free.
cards.evidence_claim: Bethel's free disc golf course offers 18 holes across campus and is open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; respect campus rules as it is private property.

cards.title: Hike the Nature Trail
cards.subtitle: Perimeter trail around Lake Valentine
cards.notes: Walk through oak savannah and wetlands on this scenic perimeter trail. It's a quiet spot for a nature break between classes.
cards.short_summary: A scenic nature trail winding through diverse ecosystems around the campus perimeter.
cards.evidence_claim: The Russell W. Johnson Nature Trail winds its way around the perimeter of the Bethel University Campus and is open for walking and running.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students and the public during daylight hours.

cards.title: Browse the Olson Gallery
cards.subtitle: Art exhibits in the Community Life Center
cards.notes: View contemporary art from national and international artists. The gallery is free and open to the public daily.
cards.short_summary: A campus art gallery featuring rotating exhibitions of professional and student work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Olson Gallery exhibits nationally and internationally established artists and is open to the public with no admission fee.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 9 a.m.-7 p.m. and weekends 11 a.m.-6 p.m.

cards.title: Play Games in the Underground
cards.subtitle: Student lounge in the Brushaber Commons
cards.notes: Challenge friends to pool, ping-pong, or classic arcade games. This renovated space is a hub for student relaxation and free entertainment.
cards.short_summary: A student community space featuring free arcade games, pool tables, and board games.
cards.evidence_claim: The Underground features new arcade games, pool and pingpong tables, and board games available for student use.
cards.access_notes: Primarily for Bethel students; features 24/7 free coffee for commuters.

cards.title: Attend Sunday Night Vespers
cards.subtitle: Student-led worship service
cards.notes: Join thousands of students for this Sunday night worship tradition. It is a stripped-down, music-focused service open to the community.
cards.short_summary: A popular weekly student-led worship gathering held on Sunday evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: Every Sunday night, the Bethel community gathers for a student-led Vespers service which is free to attend.
cards.source_title: 10 Fun Things to Do on Bethel's Campus
cards.access_notes: Held Sunday nights; open to students and the public.

cards.title: Hang by the Fire Pits
cards.subtitle: Outdoor gathering space
cards.notes: Gather around the gas fire pits for s'mores or late-night study sessions. The courtyard features LED-lit bollards and charging stations.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor patio area with fire pits and seating for social gatherings and studying.
cards.evidence_claim: The fire pits in Kresge courtyard give students a reason to get outside and gather into the evening.
cards.source_title: Bethel Student Government (BSG) Funds Patio Expansion
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space accessible year-round to the campus community.

cards.title: Rent a Board Game
cards.subtitle: Free game rentals for students
cards.notes: Check out Settlers of Catan or Codenames for a free game night. The library offers a wide selection of games for checkout with a student ID.
cards.short_summary: The campus library provides free rentals of popular board and card games to students.
cards.evidence_claim: Students can rent a variety of board games from the Bethel Library at no cost.
cards.source_title: 10 Fun Things to Do on Bethel's Campus
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid Bethel student ID for checkout.

cards.title: Join a Fitness Class
cards.subtitle: Free group workouts for students
cards.notes: Attend yoga or HIIT classes without paying a membership fee. Students get free access to all cardio and strength equipment.
cards.short_summary: A 11,000 square foot fitness facility offering free classes and equipment to students.
cards.evidence_claim: Students and employees receive free access to the Wellness Center, including group fitness classes.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; closed during chapel hours (10:10-11 a.m. MWF).

cards.title: See a Student Music Recital
cards.subtitle: Free performances in the Great Hall
cards.notes: Watch talented peers perform in this world-class acoustic venue. Most student and faculty music recitals offer free admission with a student ID.
cards.short_summary: A premier performing arts venue hosting free concerts and recitals for the university community.
cards.evidence_claim: College students receive free admission to many music performances at Benson Great Hall with a valid ID.
cards.source_title: Handbell Ensemble Spring Concert | Bethel University
cards.access_notes: Free for college students with ID at the door for most departmental events.

cards.title: Study in The Loft
cards.subtitle: Quiet lounge near the President's Office
cards.notes: Find a quiet corner to focus in this bright, elevated study space. It's a dedicated 'third space' for students to work between classes.
cards.short_summary: A bright and quiet designated study space available to all students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Loft is a bright, quiet study space available to all students, located just outside the president's office.
